doc: Structure-tensor coherence: gaussian_filter(patch, 1.0) (default mode reflect, truncate 4.0; axis 0 then axis 1; the output keeps the input dtype), np.gradient (central differences inside, one-sided at the borders), products smoothed by gaussian_filter(sigma), coherence sqrt((jxx - jyy)^2 + 4 jxy^2) / (jxx + jyy) weighted by the trace. A real patch crop (128x128, rows and columns 64..191 of the 256x256 patch at latitude 0, longitude -90 of the Earth map at 1024x512), stored as float32 and called on its float64 promotion (patches() returns float64). Float64 chain with no data-dependent branch: an independent float64 reimplementation (explicit reflect-padded kernel sums) agrees to 2.2e-16, a float64 one-ulp nudge of every texel moves the value by <= 4.4e-16; tolerance 1e-9.

params.called_with: float64 promotion of the stored float32 patch
